archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) tailored for French B2B SaaS
domain: B2B SaaS / Organisme de Formation (Qualiopi compliance)

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid (Dense, functional, gap-4 to gap-6). High data density but breathable.
spacing_and_layout.surfaces: Grid Borders (Technical look). Flat backgrounds, 1px subtle border, max 8px radius (rounded-md). Avoid glassmorphism for health/business logic data.
spacing_and_layout.sidebar: Vertical, icon-centric, w-16 or w-64 expanded. Solid white with border-r.
spacing_and_layout.topbar: Sticky, h-16, solid white background with bottom border border-slate-200. Contains global search, notifications, profile.

components_strategy.general: Use Shadcn UI extensively. Go cardless or rectangular/dense styles. Override default rounding to max-w-sm or rounded-md.
components_strategy.kanban: Flex or Grid columns. Cards inside should have 1px border, hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-md transition-all. Use badges for status.
components_strategy.data_table: Dense rows. text-sm. Hover effect on rows. Left-aligned text.
components_strategy.forms: Multi-step form for session creation. Use Shadcn form, input, select. Clear stepper indicator.
components_strategy.tabs: Fiche session requires 4 tabs. Use Shadcn Tabs, override h-9 to h-auto. Minimalist tab triggers (border-b-2 active state).

icons.usage: Use Duotone or Regular weight. 24px for sidebar, 16px/20px for inline elements.

image_urls.description: Company logo placeholder for client organizations (GitHub dice)
Company logo placeholder for client organizations (Anduril dice)

accessibility_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons and links must explicitly define hover colors (e.g., hover:bg-blue-700 hover:text-white). Use transition-colors duration-200.
accessibility_and_interactions.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Write all React components using .js or .jsx extensions (DO NOT USE .tsx or TypeScript).
Run yarn add @phosphor-icons/react recharts clsx tailwind-merge to ensure dependencies are present.
Implement Shadcn UI primitives inside src/components/ui/ manually or via CLI, but ensure they are .js files.
Create a persistent layout with a vertical sidebar on the left and a sticky top header.
Main views: Dashboard (KPI cards + Bar/Line Recharts), Sessions (Kanban board / List toggle), Session Details (4 tabs), Directory (table).
Use mocked data heavily for MVP since backend integration isn't fully ready (sessions, apprenants, formateurs).
Inject 'Cabinet Grotesk' and 'IBM Plex Sans' via standard HTML link tags in index.html.
Design rule: Avoid generic 'purple gradients'. Stick strictly to the blue/slate high-contrast palette provided.
For the Qualiopi checklist, use clear visual indicators (green checkmarks, progress bars) within the Progression tab.
